descriptionTerms_text:
Welcome to Fruit Tactics! Before you play, here is how the game works and what we do with your data.

1. Who we are
Fruit Tactics is developed by Suricatus Games. Contact: suricatusgames@gmail.com.

2. Minimum age
The game is intended for people aged 13 or older. If you are under 18, please read these terms with a parent or guardian.

3. Your account and progress
We automatically create a guest account to save your progress in the cloud. On some devices you can also sign in with the system's games account. We store: an account identifier, the player name and avatar you choose, coins, levels, scores, missions, daily rewards and settings (sound and language).

4. Leaderboard
When the leaderboard is active, your player name and score may be shown to other players. You don't have to use your real name.

5. Ads
The game is free and shows ads from Google AdMob. To do this, Google may use your device's advertising identifier, IP address and device information. In some countries we ask for your permission for personalized ads, and on iPhone the system asks whether the app may track your activity. You can decline and keep playing with non-personalized ads.

6. Usage statistics
We use Unity Analytics and Firebase Analytics to understand how the game is played (levels started and completed, screens opened, crashes) and to balance the levels. This data does not include your real name.

7. Notifications
With your permission, we send reminders such as daily reward alerts. You can turn them off in your device settings.

8. What we don't collect
We don't collect location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone or payment data.

9. Your rights
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data. To erase everything, use Settings > Delete account, or email suricatusgames@gmail.com.

10. Using the game
All game content (code, art, sounds and design) belongs to Suricatus Games. You receive a personal, non-exclusive, revocable license to play on your devices. Cheating, modifying the game or exploiting bugs for an advantage is not allowed.

11. Changes to these terms
We may update these terms and the Privacy Policy. The latest version is always available in Settings > Terms.

By tapping Accept, you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms and the Privacy Policy.
